items.title: Path Trader
items.description: Premium full-stack SaaS for Brazilian traders: trade journaling, performance analytics, AI assistant, partner program with admin workflows, and Asaas subscriptions. TypeScript monorepo (pnpm + Turborepo) with four Next.js 16 surfaces (web app, marketing site, admin, landing page) and a NestJS 11 API on Prisma + PostgreSQL. Pusher realtime notifications, AWS S3/SES, pg-boss Postgres-backed queues, OpenAI-powered chat with usage tracking, NextAuth v5 on the web and JWT + Passport on the API, Lexical journal and documents, and a Serwist PWA. Sentry observability with GitHub Actions CI deploying to Vercel and Fly.
items.summary: Premium full-stack SaaS for Brazilian traders — journaling, analytics, an AI assistant, and a partner program.
items.longDescription: Path Trader is an independent, self-funded platform that helps traders journal their operations, review performance, manage risk, and run a partner program. It is built as a TypeScript monorepo (pnpm + Turborepo) with four Next.js 16 surfaces — the web app, the marketing site, the admin panel, and the landing page — backed by a NestJS 11 API on Prisma and PostgreSQL. The product ships realtime notifications with Pusher, AWS S3/SES for storage and email, pg-boss Postgres-backed queues, and an OpenAI-powered chat assistant with usage tracking. Authentication uses NextAuth v5 on the web and JWT + Passport on the API, while the journal and documents are powered by Lexical. It is delivered as a Serwist PWA with Sentry observability and GitHub Actions CI deploying to Vercel and Fly.
highlights: pnpm + Turborepo monorepo with a shared Prisma schema and four Next.js 16 surfaces
Trade journal with imports/exports and path-rank style performance analytics
OpenAI-powered assistant with usage-aware behavior and tracking
Asaas subscriptions plus a partner program with admin approval workflows
Realtime notifications (Pusher), AWS S3/SES, and pg-boss queues
Serwist PWA with Sentry observability and GitHub Actions CI/CD

items.title: Vestra Financial Management
items.description: Mobile-first PWA for personal finance, built as a TypeScript monorepo with a Vite + React 19 dashboard, a Next.js 16 marketing site, and a NestJS API backed by Prisma on PostgreSQL. Multi-user workspaces with owner/member permissions and deep cloning, recurring transactions generated by a scheduled cron, JWT auth with refresh-token rotation, and free/pro subscription gating. Shared shadcn/ui + Tailwind 4 design system across both frontends. Deployed on Fly.io (API) and Vercel (web) with managed Neon Postgres.
items.summary: Mobile-first PWA for personal finance with multi-user workspaces and recurring transactions.
items.longDescription: Vestra is a mobile-first PWA for personal finance, built as a TypeScript monorepo that combines a Vite + React 19 dashboard, a Next.js 16 marketing site, and a NestJS API backed by Prisma on PostgreSQL. It supports multi-user workspaces with owner/member permissions and deep cloning, recurring transactions generated by a scheduled cron, JWT authentication with refresh-token rotation, and free/pro subscription gating. A shared shadcn/ui + Tailwind 4 design system keeps both frontends consistent. The stack is deployed on Fly.io (API) and Vercel (web) with a managed Neon Postgres database.
highlights: Multi-user workspaces with owner/member permissions and deep cloning
Recurring transactions generated by a scheduled cron job
Shared shadcn/ui + Tailwind 4 design system across both frontends
Deployed on Fly.io and Vercel with managed Neon Postgres

items.title: Rick and Morty Explorer
items.description: An animated series explorer following the adventures of a super scientist and his grandson, featuring complex character relationships and intergalactic discoveries.
items.summary: An animated series explorer for characters, episodes, and locations powered by GraphQL.
items.longDescription: Rick and Morty Explorer is an animated series explorer that follows the adventures of a super scientist and his grandson, surfacing complex character relationships and intergalactic discoveries. Built with Next.js and React on TypeScript, it consumes the public Rick and Morty GraphQL API to browse characters, episodes, and locations with a responsive Tailwind CSS interface.
highlights: Browse characters, episodes, and locations from the series
Powered by the public Rick and Morty GraphQL API
Built with Next.js, React, and TypeScript
Responsive interface styled with Tailwind CSS
